mechanism: Carbamazepine induces CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, increasing metabolism of levodopa and reducing its therapeutic efficacy; additionally, both drugs can cause CNS effects and carbamazepine may lower levodopa levels through hepatic enzyme induction.
action: Monitor for reduced antiparkinsonian efficacy; levodopa dose may need to be increased; consider alternative anticonvulsant if possible or adjust levodopa dosing based on clinical response.
